name: Album Cover and Idle Screen
author: Vestra Player
punchline: Shows the album cover for audio only and a logo when idle
description:
While audio without a picture plays, shows the album cover with title, artist and album; with no media open, shows a logo (which can be replaced with your own image); while media opens, shows a loading screen.
Entries: Audio ▸ Show Album Cover for Audio Only, Settings ▸ Appearance.
